answer: Each epoch samples a slice of submissions for audit. Peer disagreement dilutes the score instead of voiding it, so a split panel costs the submitter weight. Rewards vest against future work. The result is a continuous check rather than one gate at the end. Sampling means the attacker never knows which task gets re-run, so every fake delivery carries the same expected loss. A crystal of a fake receipt survives one epoch, not many. A glacier of stacked accounts moves slowly, and the horizon keeps receding. Cost: duplicated work plus vesting time on every account.
